events.name: Old Wooden Chest
events.description: You find an old chest partially buried in the ground.

events.name: Locked Iron Chest
events.description: A sturdy iron chest sits here, locked tight.

events.name: Bandit Ambush
events.description: Bandits jump out from hiding and attack!

attacks.name: Slash
attacks.description: The bandit slashes at you with a rusty blade.

attacks.name: Stab
attacks.description: The bandit lunges forward with a quick stab.

attacks.name: Kick
attacks.description: The bandit kicks you back to create distance.

attacks.name: Throw Knife
attacks.description: A knife flies toward you from the bandit's hand.

events.name: Wild Beast
events.description: A ferocious creature blocks your path.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.description: The beast bites down with powerful jaws.

attacks.name: Claw
attacks.description: Sharp claws rake across your body.

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.description: A deafening roar shakes you, leaving you vulnerable.

attacks.name: Pounce
attacks.description: The beast leaps and crashes into you.

events.name: Blessed Shrine
events.description: A shrine radiates energy, granting you a blessing.

events.name: Healing Light
events.description: A warm light surrounds you, restoring your strength.

events.name: Poisonous Fog
events.description: A toxic mist weakens your body.

events.name: Cursed Ground
events.description: The ground beneath you drains your energy.

events.name: Skeleton Warrior
events.description: An undead warrior rises and attacks.

attacks.name: Bone Strike
attacks.description: The skeleton swings a brittle arm at you.

attacks.name: Shield Bash
attacks.description: A sudden bash knocks the wind out of you.

attacks.name: Rattle
attacks.description: The skeleton rattles loudly, unsettling you.

attacks.name: Pierce
attacks.description: A sharp weapon pierces toward your chest.

events.name: Ancient Knowledge
events.description: You uncover knowledge that sharpens your mind.

events.name: Stairs
events.description: Stairs leading to the next floor await you.

events.name: Shadow Lord
events.description: The Shadow Lord stands before you, radiating dark energy!

attacks.name: Dark Bolt
attacks.description: The Shadow Lord fires a bolt of dark energy!

attacks.name: Shadow Slash
attacks.description: A blade of shadow cuts through the air!

attacks.name: Soul Drain
attacks.description: You feel your life force being drained!

attacks.name: Dark Pulse
attacks.description: A wave of darkness crashes over you!
